_comment: Template for a repair service entry. Copy to a city-based filename like <shopname>_<city>.json and fill in.
name: Shop display name
method: What they do (e.g. Chip-off NAND/UFS, EDL via Firehose, Mi Unlock service)
_proven_note: Set to true ONLY if the person adding this entry personally recovered a device there. Verified entries get a green badge in the Service Report.
price_en: Approximate price range in local currency + USD estimate
price_ru: Approximate price range in local currency + USD estimate (Russian text)
notes_en: Short free-form notes: who they are, what tools they have, their reputation. Keep under 2 sentences.
contact: How to reach them (WhatsApp, Telegram, phone, website — not full numbers for privacy)
